why: Source: spot the pie's base trap, sum three slices, multiply by the bar share, reject the others (one scaled check, a base-trap check and a no-data check) (about 5 steps); question: the same base trap, three-slice sum x 28%, the same rejections (about 5 steps).

Source: fixed cost in dollars, contribution per revenue dollar, break-even revenue, percentage increase (4 steps); question: fixed operating cost in dollars, 13c contribution, break-even sales, percentage increase (4 steps).
Source: reference segment's share, sum five bar totals, multiply, round (about 3 steps); question: Clothing's share (12 / 36), sum five totals, multiply, round (about 3 steps).

Source: sum all groups, flat uplift on everyone, subtract from target, weighted equation with a 2x ratio, solve, scale (about 5 steps); question: the same sum, flat pass, subtraction, weighted equation with a 3x ratio, solve, scale (about 5 steps).

Source: realise the league-wide win rate is 50%, note the middle group sits at 50%, balance the deviations of the other two groups, solve (about 3-4 steps); question: the same 50% insight, the same balancing of 2 x 10 against X x 5, solve (about 3-4 steps).
Source: read five labelled bars, sum two groups, apply -20% and +30%, add (about 5 steps); question: the same readings and groupings, apply -25% and +30%, add (about 5 steps).
Source: fixed cost in dollars, contribution margin, break-even revenue, percentage increase (4 steps); question: the same four steps with a 37c contribution (4 steps).

Source: size a 1% cut in the big variable cost, a 1% cut in the fixed cost (and its sub-part), a 1% revenue rise net of the in-line variable cost, compare (about 4 steps, including the revenue trap); question: the same three sizings with the same in-line wage trap and comparison (about 4 steps).
Source: reference segment's share (25%), sum five totals, multiply, round (about 3 steps); question: Business's share (25%), sum five totals, multiply, round (about 3 steps).
Source: two growth x driver-share products for the first and last bars, difference, round (about 4 steps); question: the same two products, difference, round (about 4 steps).
